technical.summary: Bullish momentum with strong short-term confluence (golden cross, hull flip, three white soldiers) but limited by intermediate-term weakness (below 200-EMA) and overbought conditions; moderate swing entry with elevated risk.

fundamental.summary: OMC shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 69 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Weak bearish congressional signal from small sales by McCaul (97+ days old) combined with neutral market fear/greed and absent news data provides insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (343), CPI event imminent (0 days), and negative macro score (-6) create hostile environment for Communication Services; earnings in 69 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three confluent short-term bullish technicals (golden cross, hull flip, three white soldiers) with tech_score of 7 provide tactical momentum entry near support at 61.43.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, CPI event imminent), price below 200-EMA, zero fundamental support, overbought conditions, and hostile risk environment (macro score -6) overwhelm weak technical signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum (golden cross, hull flip, three white soldiers) offers tactical entry near support, but macro environment is severely hostile with inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, and imminent CPI event creating unacceptable risk/reward asymmetry.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve and VIX crisis (343) signal recession risk; earnings in 69 days combined with zero fundamental support and overbought technicals create high probability of sharp reversal.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical score insufficient to overcome macro, fundamental, and sentiment weakness
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding OMC with 36 other Communication Services positions (7.4% sector concentration); adding to existing position during macro crisis and sector headwinds violates concentration and risk management rules.
